title: Meet an index and document
summary: An index is a group of searchable documents.
introduction: An index is a group of searchable documents. Your task: Identify the index name and document id in the path.
learningObjectives: Identify the index name and document id in the path.
Explain the example for meet an index and document

blocks.text: An index is a group of searchable documents. A document has named fields, such as title and page count.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: The request path names the index and document id.
The JSON body contains the searchable source fields, each with its own value.

blocks.text: The practice index receives document 1. The response reports whether it was created or updated.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a disposable local index. Explicit mappings in the next lesson make field behaviour clearer than relying on guesses.
